'''The Case Law of Us''' is a legal-history surface of the [[SoapBox]] civic ecosystem, published at caselaw.soapbox.community. It reads American history through the case reporters — the published record of court decisions — rather than through secondary narrative.

== What it covers ==
* '''Figures who live in the caselaw''' — historical people whose lives are documented in the decisions of the courts.
* '''Courts doing history''' — opinions in which courts themselves undertake historical analysis to decide a question.
* '''The ancient roots of written law''' — the early codes that first put law into writing.

== Verification ==
The surface states that every case it cites was verified to exist, consistent with the [[SoapBox Law]] discipline of source-linked, keyless reference. The material is descriptive legal history, not legal advice.
